The '''fiber-chained razorhat''' was a saucer-shaped article both worn as a garment and wielded as a thrown weapon by the ''[[go-zeki]]'' [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] of the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. A [[fiber-chain]] linked to the [[Hat/Legends|hat]] allowed it to return to the user after an attack.<ref name="Wolf" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke]]" occur during those of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> three razorhat-armed ''go-zeki'' were active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], until they were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Fomadu]].<ref name="Wolf" />
